content: En mehn Israel ar Kahpwal nan Isip
Iet eden nein Seikop pwutak ko me iangih kohdihla Isip, emenemen irail iangahki eh peneinei:
Reupen, Simion, Lipai, Suda,
Isakar, Sepulon, Pensamin,
Dan, Napdali, Kad, oh Aser.
Eri, koaros me uhdahn kisehn kadaudok en Seikop patpene me isiakan. A Sosep ketiketier nan Isip.
Eri, Sosep oh rie ko, iangahki diho koaros, melahr.
Kadaudokarail ko, mehn Israel ko, ahpw kaparaparala oh inenen tohtohla; re pil kehlailla oh audehla wasa koaros nan sahpwo.
Eri, nanmwarki kapw emen, me sohte mwahn mwahngih duwen Sosep, ahpw kesepwilda nan Isip.
E ahpw mahsanihong sapwellime aramas akan, “Kumwail kilang duwen mehn Israel kan ar wie tohtohla oh kehlailasang kitail. Met keper mehlel ong kitail.
Eri, e konehng kitail en wiahiong irail ehu koasoandien pwe re dehr tohtohla. Pwe, ni ahnsoun mahwen, re de miniminiong atail imwintihti kan oh mahweniong kitail, oh pil lipalahsang rehtail.”

Eri, mehn Isip ko koasoanediong arail kaunen doadoahk pwe re en kin itonehng irail nan doadoahk apwal re lao luwetala. Iei mehn Israel ko me kauwadahng Parao kahnimw kan en Pitom oh Rameses, wasahn nekidala mwenge.
Eri soh, ni uwen mehn Isip ar kaloke mehn Israel ko, re pil tohtohlahsang mahs oh parpeseng wasa koaros nan sahpwo. Mehn Isip ko eri masakala mehn Israel ko.
Re kin itonehng irail nan mour apwal en kalidu oh nan doadoahk laud en wiahda ihmw, oh pil soangen doadoahk koaros en nansapw. Re sohte kin poakeirailla.
Nanmwarkien Isip ahpw pil mahsanihong Sipra oh Pua sounkeneitik ko, me kin sewese lihen Ipru ko,
“Ni amwa pahn kin sewese kanaitikih lihen Ipru kan, ma serio ipwidi kisin pwutak, a kumwa kemehla; a ma kisin serepein, a kumwa kamourala.”
Ahpw sounkeneitik ko, lih masak Koht riemen, ihme ira sohte peikikiong nanmwarkio; pwe ira kin kamourala kisin pwutak kan.
Nanmwarkio eri malipeirahdo, oh keinemwe rehra, “Dahme kumwa kin kamourkihla seri ohl akan?”
Lih ako eri sapeng, patohwan, “Lihen Ipru kan sohte duwehte lihen Isip kan; pwe re kin mengei en neitik, oh serio kin ipwidi mwohn sounkeneitik eh kin lel rehrail.”
Eri, Koht ketin kupwurehla sounkeneitik ko, oh mehn Israel ko pil wie tohtohlahte oh kekehlailla.
Pwehki sounkeneitik ko ara masak Koht, Koht ketikihong ira neira seri tohto.
Parao eri mahsanihong sapwellime aramas koaros kosonned wet: ‘Kumwail kesehla nan Pillap Nail seri ohl koaros me ipwidihsang mehn Ipru kan, a kumwail kamourala serepein koaros.”
